title: Bijection from affine seed matrices to exact-length Boolean tapes
claims: AffineSeedTapeBijection gives a checked finite bijection via contiguous bias and coefficient bits in row order.
The theorem shows that each exact-length tape is the encoding of exactly one affine seed matrix.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against pinned definitions.
